Taipei, Taiwan388 contributions

Not a Single Miss
May 2026 • Solo
During this solo dinner at El Gaucho, the house bread arrived first, steaming hot. It was shatteringly crisp rather than tough or dry. The sweet, roasted garlic, spread over the bread, tasted excellent. Next, the chef personally served the Rib Eye Cap on a heated plate. The steak was flawless. It had a charred crust and burst with juice. Dipping it into the Chimichurri cut through the rich fat cleanly and elevated the taste. Then the truffle fries arrived with a rich beef tallow aroma. With Parmesan, they were addictive. Drinking the homemade lemonade sharply reset the palate between these heavy dishes. The wall-facing table felt slightly narrow once all the dishes arrived. Overall, the food here is an absolute triumph.

Unbelievably high prices - stay away
Aug 2025 • Couples
BE CAREFUL - STAY AWAY - unbelievably high prices!!!
The meat is super expensive and if you consider the yield, which is half than normal, it gets to Singapore or Kobe prices.
To give you an idea: we paid for 1.5 kg and we ate 500 grams (net of the bone and the fat). We ate meat all over the world and usually, you eat at least 800 grams.

150 euros per kg which become 300 euros!!!!!!!
12 euros for a small fee even salad
7 euros for a bottle of still water.

STAY AWAY!!
